# The HPACK and QPACK Huffman code

This module provides the Huffman code for HPACK and QPACK.

## Model

The fixed Huffman code maps input bytes to variable-width bit codes. The same table serves HPACK and QPACK.

## Contracts

Decode validates terminal bits and bounds output by the supplied room. Invalid codes and exhausted output room have distinct errors.

## Executable example

```fern test name=std-http-huffman-example
import "std/http/huffman";
import "std/string";

function main(): i32 {
  let coded = huffman.encode([], "hello".as_bytes());
  let Ok(plain) = huffman.decode(coded[:], 5) else { return 1; };
  if (plain.len() != 5 || plain[0] != 104 as u8) { return 2; }
  return 0;
}
```

### `4 pub function (e: HuffmanError) message(): string`

```fern
<<4 pub function (e: HuffmanError) message(): string>>=
pub function (e: HuffmanError) message(): string {
  match (e) {
    InvalidCode => {
      return "invalid HTTP Huffman code";
    },
    ExceedsRoom => {
      return "decoded HTTP Huffman data exceeds its limit";
    }
  }
  return "";
}

pub function (e: HuffmanError) to_string(): string {
  return e.message();
}
```

### `6 pub function encoded_len(bytes: [u8]): i32`

```fern
<<6 pub function encoded_len(bytes: [u8]): i32>>=
pub function encoded_len(bytes: [u8]): i32 {
  let bits: i32 = 0;
  for b in bytes {
    bits = bits + HUFF_LEN[b as i32] as i32;
  }
  return (bits + 7) / 8;
}

pub function encode(out: u8[], bytes: [u8]): u8[] {
  let o: u8[] = out;
  let acc: i64 = 0;
  let n: i32 = 0;
  for b in bytes {
    let e: i64 = HUFF[b as i32];
    let len: i32 = (e & 255) as i32;
    acc = acc << len | e >> 8;
    n = n + len;
    while (n >= 8) {
      n = n - 8;
      o = o.append((acc >> n & 255) as u8);
    }
  }
  if (n > 0) {
    acc = acc << 8 - n | ((1 << 8 - n) - 1) as i64;
    o = o.append((acc & 255) as u8);
  }
  return o;
}

// encoded_len_digits and encode_digits code n >= 0 spelled in decimal, as
// encoded_len and encode code its digits' bytes.
pub function encoded_len_digits(n: i64): i32 {
  let bits: i32 = 0;
  let p: i64 = __decimal_top(n);
  while (p > 0) {
    bits = bits + HUFF_LEN[48 + (n / p % 10) as i32] as i32;
    p = p / 10;
  }
  return (bits + 7) / 8;
}

pub function encode_digits(out: u8[], n: i64): u8[] {
  let o: u8[] = out;
  let acc: i64 = 0;
  let k: i32 = 0;
  let p: i64 = __decimal_top(n);
  while (p > 0) {
    let e: i64 = HUFF[48 + (n / p % 10) as i32];
    let len: i32 = (e & 255) as i32;
    acc = acc << len | e >> 8;
    k = k + len;
    while (k >= 8) {
      k = k - 8;
      o = o.append((acc >> k & 255) as u8);
    }
    p = p / 10;
  }
  if (k > 0) {
    acc = acc << 8 - k | ((1 << 8 - k) - 1) as i64;
    o = o.append((acc & 255) as u8);
  }
  return o;
}

// __decimal_top is the power of ten of n's leading digit.
function __decimal_top(n: i64): i64 {
  let p: i64 = 1;
  while (n / p >= 10) {
    p = p * 10;
  }
  return p;
}

pub function decode(coded: [u8], room: i32): Result[u8[], HuffmanError] {
  let out: u8[] = __alloc_u8(coded.len() * 8 / 5 + 1);
  __arr_set_len(out, 0);
  let state: i32 = 0;
  let entry: i32 = DEC_ACCEPT;
  for b in coded {
    entry = HUFF_DEC[state * 16 + (b as i32 >> 4)];
    if ((entry & DEC_FAIL) != 0) {
      return Err(InvalidCode);
    }
    if ((entry & DEC_EMIT) != 0) {
      if (out.len() >= room) {
        return Err(ExceedsRoom);
      }
      out = out.append((entry & 255) as u8);
    }
    entry = HUFF_DEC[(entry >> 11) * 16 + (b as i32 & 15)];
    if ((entry & DEC_FAIL) != 0) {
      return Err(InvalidCode);
    }
    if ((entry & DEC_EMIT) != 0) {
      if (out.len() >= room) {
        return Err(ExceedsRoom);
      }
      out = out.append((entry & 255) as u8);
    }
    state = entry >> 11;
  }
  if ((entry & DEC_ACCEPT) == 0) {
    return Err(InvalidCode);
  }
  return Ok(out);
}
```
